_doc: Panchina phase 2: World 2026-27 named substitutes per competition (fase2.md: official text or observed max of 24 real 2026-27 team sheets; null = unknown -> the game's original bench of 5). Keys = the world packs' country dirs and competition keys; a league = one value per division (pack order). 'used' = substitutions allowed (5 everywhere found); 'et' = extra substitute in extra time (1 where the rule is known). Owner: SWOS Panchina. 'continental': the cup's name as the game writes it (a contest without a country: ' ' + name, or the name). A country competition's value may be {'named': n, 'et': 1} (an extra-time substitute). 4.0.5 (Davide 30/10): a null (or a missing key) is filled at build time (benchx.bench_table): a lower division from the nearest higher division with data, a cup / state championship from the country's top league, or '=league.N' = division N's (the cup of that division's clubs). 'sources': where each 4.0.5 value comes from (internal/reports/bench-unknowns-2627.md). A continental cup's 'qual': 1 = the career club's qualifying tie too (uefaq's 'PRELIM. ' / 'QUAL. ' / 'QUALIF. ' / 'QUALI. ' + the name without 'UEFA ': UEFA regulations Art. 55 / 56 cover all the competition's matches, qualifying included). 4.0.5 worldwide: each country also gets a prefix entry '<button> ' (any title of the country: its play-offs, supercups, cups without data) = its top league, or 'confederations'[pack continent] for a country with no data. 'confederations': the bench of a country with no data (its pack's continent).
